summary: Iteration 3.5 UI polish verification + full frontend regression re-run on Now Kart (backend skipped per request, no backend changes this round). Verified both CSS-only changes via Playwright on mobile viewport (375x667) against the live public URL with real Shopify data. UI Change 1 (Product Detail square image container): confirmed on 2 different products (Diamonds Frozen Paratha, Diamonds Frozen Idly) - image bounding box measured at exactly 327x327px (perfect square), image centered both axes, contentFit='contain' preserves aspect ratio with no stretching/cropping, balanced padding, no excessive dead whitespace. UI Change 2 (ProductCard 2-line title): confirmed on Home Best Sellers rail (6 cards, all measured cardHeight=220, titleHeight=40 identical regardless of 1-line vs multi-word titles) and on Search results grid with 20 products including genuinely long titles that wrap to 2 lines ('MDH Pav Bhaji Masala', 'Everest Pav Bhaji Masala - 100g') - every single card height measured exactly 220px, zero variance. Both changes are working as intended, pure visual improvements with no regressions. Regression re-run: Home rails render, free-delivery banner dismiss works, add-to-cart from home card updates cart badge (0->1) correctly, Categories tab -> collection navigation works correctly and shows correct matching products (verified /categories -> Snacks category card -> /collection/snacks route with correct title and product), Product Detail 404 fix (from iteration 4) re-verified still working - navigating to /product/some-nonexistent-handle-test correctly shows dedicated 'Product not found' view, not the generic retry-loop error screen. Search screen debounced live search works and returns correct filtered results. No console errors found other than an expected/benign 404 network log entry when intentionally testing a nonexistent product handle (not a JS/app error).
critical_code_review_comments: Product Detail imageWrap style correctly uses aspectRatio: 1 + maxWidth: 480 + alignSelf: 'center' with imageInner padding: spacing.xl - clean square container implementation, matches requested behavior exactly.

ProductCard title style correctly uses minHeight: 40 with numberOfLines={2} - reserves consistent space so row/grid card heights never vary based on title length; verified empirically across 26+ cards with a mix of 1-line and 2-line titles, all measured identical 220px card height.

Both changes are purely additive/style-only as described - no data-fetching, business logic, navigation, or animation code was touched; FadeIn/FadeInDown/FadeInRight entrance animations still present and unaffected.

Minor observation (test-tooling only, not an app bug): when driving navigation through the bottom tab bar + category taps in rapid succession within the same long-lived browser session, occasional stale click targeting was observed due to FlatList/ScrollView virtualization + reused browser context across separate test script invocations - resolved by navigating via direct URL/fresh page load, which produced correct, deterministic results every time. Not something end users would encounter in normal single-session usage.
